notes.title: Major Update A.0.11.5
notes.content:
[h1]Update A.0.11.5 – Session Creation, Search, and New Maps[/h1]

[h2]Session Creation[/h2]
[list]
    [*]You can now create custom sessions with settings.[/*]
    [*]Set privacy parameters, including session name and password.[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/b2dafa6df81ee933fbdff5187a601fdb40cf9c02.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Session Search[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Added the ability to search for active sessions in a list format.[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/7629efc5fd5fab1d03468663254dac0881c5fa0f.png[/img]
    [*]Filtering is not yet available but will be implemented later.[/*]
[/list]

[h2]New Maps[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Skatepark – Grind City – a park with ramps and trick zones.[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/101526eca315b53ccd6ebfb7a5f44c482f8bdccb.jpg[/img]
    [*]Parking Zone - Underground – a multi-level space for drifting and maneuvering.[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/98c34710fd253829cd05679b3bff64f2b0c9d16b.jpg[/img]
    [*]Cargo Bay – an industrial area with containers and open spaces.[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/3b131ad45135b84c92556d896d2b42d97171eb86.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Added physical props that are replicated in online sessions.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]GH Games[/h1]

notes.title: The Replay System in Update A.0.11.0
notes.content:
[h1]Update A.0.11.0 - Replays[/h1]

[h2]Interface[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Some elements in the menu have been reworked or added.[/*]  
[*]The Screenshots tab is now replaced with the Media tab, which is divided into two sections: Screenshots and Replays.[/*]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/99939c4089a1b52e8a0656bb4b77298a56ef625f.png[/img]  
[*]The main button, Let's Drive, no longer just creates a local session without online functionality. It now offers a limited selection: Single Race, Create Session, or Join the First Available Session.[/*]  
[*]In the Replay menu, you can view, delete, or rename replays.[/*]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/3ddac438699f3e1ce41656cd36f433e8697e6847.png[/img]
[/list]  

[h2]Settings[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Replays now feature extensive functionality, allowing you to capture stunning and atmospheric shots![/*]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/0a84c84585e81b7267938c15ccfe9623117c392c.jpg[/img]  
[*]Camera functionality has also been integrated into replays, enabling the same adjustments available during sessions.[/*]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/e9baa8b1cc8fdf86d7ccc196b7fdcb058970d2cb.jpg[/img]
[/list]  

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]A critical bug that caused the client to disconnect from the host after a while has been fixed. This issue no longer occurs.[/*]  
[/list]  

[h1]GH Games[/h1]

notes.title: Happy New Year Update A.0.10.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/938372e5161c3f172c61e6a275331bdadb7ccf2d.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Year Update A.0.10.1[/h1]

    [h2]Interface[/h2]
    [list]
        [*]Complete menu redesign (WIP).[/*]
        [*]Added a layout to the menu where players can view the key bindings used in the game. The visualization is stylized and displayed on a gamepad and keyboard (the gamepad layout corresponds to "Xbox One Controller").[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/de7c834ddc273d1159b4ebac2f3190972bb5d82b.png[/img]
        [*]A button was added to the main menu for accessing the folder with high-resolution screenshots if they were created by the player.[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/815a80e9d7380ea77a7fb855e1568bc2ac40c609.png[/img]
    [/list]

    [h2]Settings[/h2]
    [list]
        [*]Graphics settings and general settings are now saved in separate files, reducing unnecessary overwriting of variables (might be unstable).[/*]
    [/list]

    [h2]Gameplay[/h2]
    [list]
        [*]Temporarily removed the online mode to optimize the network code for future implementation.[/*]
        [*]Replaced the default car "Rynoo AWD Electric" with "Rynoo AWD Nitro" for offline mode exploration. This car has unique mechanics, including forward-only movement.[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/ffd4a3360213f7c37d168302a60e82b81342962a.jpg[/img]
    [/list]

    [h2]Photography[/h2]
    [list]
        [*]Added the ability to take photos directly from the engine, achieving higher image quality compared to regular screenshots.[/*]
        [*]Added screenshot resolution and aspect ratio settings to the camera mode.[/*]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993225/8f384a4f95254392dca8adba65bcb638e46b737f.jpg[/img]
        [*]Drone mode was added to the camera, activated by pressing Z (described in the key bindings layout). In this mode, you can adjust speed and sensitivity, as well as tilt the camera (hold "Ctrl" and scroll the mouse wheel). Without "Ctrl," it adjusts the camera’s field of view.[/*]
    [/list]

    [h2]Features[/h2]
    [list]
        [*]For the New Year update, a festive hat was added to the cars.[/*]
    [/list]

[h1]GH Games[/h1]
